name: United States
description: Follow United States, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: The Uplift: The American Dream
changes.summary: We celebrate the United States ahead of its 250th anniversary with stories about American heroes and pastimes. The founder of e.l.f. Cosmetics shares how he made a massive life change to become a Catholic priest.

changes.title: Staying in a job for the health insurance? About 1 in 4 Americans do, a survey says
changes.summary: About 24% of U.S. employees stay in unwanted jobs just for health insurance, a report out Wednesday finds. Up significantly since 2021, the uptick in "job lock" is a concerning sign for the U.S. economy. (Image credit: Creative Images Lab).

changes.title: U.S. identifies 3rd service member ‘believed’ killed in Iranian attack
changes.summary: The United States military identified Angel S. Rampersad as a third servicemember believed to have been killed in Jordan after an Iranian attack last Friday.

changes.title: Trump’s 50% Tariffs on Canada: What to Know, and What’s Next
changes.summary: The president said punishing 50 percent tariffs would begin by Aug. 19, a significant escalation of the trade war between Canada and the U.S. that he started over a year ago.

changes.title: Sen. Bennet rails against trade chief for Trump policy's impact on farmers
changes.summary: Sen. Michael Bennet, a Democrat from Washington, challenged some of U.S. Trade Representative Jamieson Greer's assertions about the successes of President Trump's trade policies and their impact on farmers.

changes.title: "Nothing is going through" the Strait of Hormuz, shipping insider says
changes.summary: Despite U.S. assertions, the CEO of a maritime risk firm says "there is no guarantee of safe passage" through the Strait of Hormuz.

changes.title: Trump will attend the dignified transfer of 4 U.S. service members killed in the Middle East
changes.summary: The ritual is one of the most somber duties of a commander-in-chief.

changes.title: U.S.-Saudi Nuclear Deal Stokes Israeli Concerns of Mideast Arms Race
changes.summary: An Israeli minister sought to downplay the agreement, while critics said it could spur other regional countries to pursue a nuclear program, and potentially the creation of a bomb.

changes.title: Latest on U.S.-Saudi nuclear deal, Trump threats against Iranian infrastructure
changes.summary: CBS News National security analyst Aaron MacLean breaks down President Trump's threats against Iranian infrastructure and the United States' new nuclear deal with Saudi Arabia.

changes.title: Waltz clashes with Rep. Jackson over Cuba question: "Absolute propaganda"
changes.summary: U.S. Ambassador to the United Nations Mike Waltz testified Wednesday in front of the House Foreign Affairs Committee, where he and Rep. Jonathan L. Jackson had a tense exchange on the current U.S.-Cuba situation.
